disclaimer: All SLO targets below are PROPOSED engineering hypotheses for local/sandbox calibration, NOT contractual SLAs or assertions of production performance. Establish measured environment baselines before ratifying production targets.

slis.name: Market Data Freshness
slis.good_event_definition: Tick availability age <= 2.0s and zero sequence gaps
slis.proposed_target: 99.5% of ticks fresh within 2.0s (PROPOSED - sandbox calibration)

slis.name: OMS Queue Lag
slis.proposed_target: p99 <= 0.150s in local paper pipeline (PROPOSED - sandbox calibration)

slis.name: Broker Acknowledgment Latency
slis.proposed_target: p95 <= 0.250s in paper sandbox (PROPOSED - sandbox calibration)

slis.name: Order Acceptance Ratio
slis.good_event_definition: Order status in {accepted, filled} / total submitted
slis.proposed_target: Reject ratio < 25% over rolling window (PROPOSED - sandbox calibration)

slis.name: End-to-End Trace Correlation & Timeliness
slis.good_event_definition: All 6 service hops share trace_id and ingest within 5.0s

slis.name: Observability Pipeline Heartbeat
slis.good_event_definition: Collector heartbeat age <= 10.0s and backend healthy
slis.proposed_target: Heartbeat gap detected within 10.0s via independent watchdog (PROPOSED)
